_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0/62 base rate on ±2-point moves makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call — a directional bet here is a claim to see a breaker that neither brain can confirm with current liquidity at zero.
next_move.brains_agree: Split: Analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing trapped consolidation; Narrative implies sideways-to-higher resolution with 0.75 confidence — the judge sides with the analyst's HOLD on statistical grounds while acknowledging the structural setup.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows > 30 AND fed_liquidity > 15 with btc_momentum_30d holding above 50
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows stays below 10 AND fed_liquidity stays below 5 for next 2 readings, forcing retest toward Anxiety
